models.deep_factory module¶

Deep Learning Model Factory.

models.deep_factory.create_deep_model(model_name: str, cfg: dict)[source]¶

Factory function to create deep learning models.

Parameters:

  • model_name – Name of the model to create.

  • cfg – Configuration dictionary.

Returns:

Instantiated model or None if not a deep model.

models.helper_factory module¶

Factory for Classical and Supplemental ML Models.

class models.helper_factory.HelperModelFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory class to create instances of supplemental ML models. Supports Clustering, Dimensionality Reduction, and Association Rule Learning.

classmethod create_model(model_name: str, **kwargs)[source]¶

Create a model instance based on the provided name.

Parameters:

  • model_name – Name of the algorithm (e.g., ‘kmeans’, ‘pca’, ‘apriori’).

  • **kwargs – Hyperparameters for the model.

Returns:

An instance of ClassicalModel.

classmethod list_available_models()[source]¶

Returns a list of all available model names.
